First, must say that we were very fortunate to find company and people so dedicated and professional. As a start-up company with a vision in providing the best radiology diagnostics and healthcare, we are so happy that we chose Goring Medical Projects Ltd for powering up our Siemens Symphony TIM 1.5T MRI system. We are sure that our cooperation will not end there and we will continue to rely on Goring Medical Projects Ltd moving forwards. I would also like to take the opportunity to thank Wayne Goring for being so kind and helpful and for setting new standards in professionalism. His knowledge of MRI systems is outstanding and without precedent! thank you once again and wish you all the best!

ALEKSANDAR MUSTAFU OWNER

After several projects together, we’re very pleased with the technical expertise of Goring Medical Projects and appreciate their professional efficiency. They make things simple – offering great trouble-shooting and clever recommendations that help us cut costs and do things in smarter ways. The MRI team solved problems before we even knew they existed (and certainly before they became greater concerns).

This team has our back! I have trust in Goring Medical Projects Ltd that I have for no other EU/UK service provider—all around an impressive and engaged group. I’m regularly looking for ways to involve Goring Medical Projects Ltd more and more in our projects.

BRIAN VON GUNTEN – VP EUROPEAN OPERATIONS BLOCK IMAGING - HOLT - MICHIGAN - UNITED STATES

In a very short timescale, Goring Medical Projects worked together to provide us with excellent technical advice and comprehensive and professional project management services. They have provided excellent customer service, equipment and value in a very short timescale and I look forward to working with them again for future requirements.

COREY FRAZER IMAGING MANAGER

I am emailing you to let you know how happy I am with your service. Starting with Wayne who stayed in contact throughout the process updating me, he has received several phone calls from me asking questions and has always been contactable. Your team are so professional and knowledgeable. Wayne was always on-hand and helpful throughout. His hands on training let me understand a lot more about the service we now can offer with the help of work by Wayne and his team. Lastly, you worked professionally, considerately, with excellent knowledge. I could not recommend the service received any higher.

Joe Piconas Managing Director
